title: Square Forces Bitcoin on Four Million Merchants
script_summary:
**BITCOIN INFRASTRUCTURE JUST LAPPED PRICE**

Square just forced four million merchants into Bitcoin acceptance overnight — no opt-in, no friction. That's not a feature rollout. That's distribution infrastructure at scale using the Apple Pay playbook.

Meanwhile, middle-income earners are borrowing against Bitcoin to buy houses without triggering tax events. Ninety percent of Lava's users are collateralizing self-sovereign wealth instead of selling. That's a jailbreak from the fiat wealth ladder
